note: OpenAPI accuracy (breaking). BREAKING served URLs: an explicit #[route(path = "/my_route")] is no longer kebab-cased (serves /my_route, not /my-route); only file/module-derived segments are. BREAKING output location: relative openapi = "..." paths resolve against CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR (workspace members now write next to their own Cargo.toml); the vespera cache dir honours CARGO_TARGET_DIR and the workspace probe matches a real [workspace] table. Generated spec changes: Path<Struct> params are typed per field (serde names), scalar Path<T> on multi-segment routes documents strings; Query<Struct> skips skip/skip_deserializing fields, expands flatten, and Vec fields carry style: form, explode: true (Parameter gains style/explode); {*rest} wildcards are documented as {rest}; impl IntoResponse/Response/Redirect responses are description-only, Html<T> is text/html, Sse is text/event-stream, Bytes/Vec<u8>/&[u8] are octet-stream binary, header arrays are metadata; Option<Json<T>> request bodies are required: false and Bytes/BytesMut/Body bodies are octet-stream; serde_json::Value is {} and std Duration is {secs, nanos} (other qualified Durations {}); flatten Option<T> makes T fields optional; enum rename_all no longer renames struct-variant fields and rename_all_fields is supported; deny_unknown_fields emits additionalProperties: false. Serve: serve() provides ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>; new serve_with_graceful_shutdown(addr, signal) (Serve trait gained a method).
